unresolved: Per-sample metal values only in Figure 14; not read.
Methods state FAAS wavelengths 'between 350 and 400 nm', which do not match the usual cadmium, zinc or iron lines.
Mean iron 0.145 ppm across a set that includes iron supplements is implausibly low; possibly a unit or dilution issue.
Lead, arsenic and mercury were not measured; uranium and radon results are radiological and not extracted.
